def VTask.IsMinBadSeq {α : Type u_2} (r : α → α → Prop)
    (rk : α → ℕ) (s : Set α) (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : ℕ → α,
    (∀ i, g i ∈ s) ∧
    (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ r (g i) (g j)) ∧
    (∀ i < n, g i = f i) →
    ¬(rk (g n) < rk (f n))
